name: Hello, Harley. // Goodbye, Daydrinking.
source:
Dirkradia makes her presence known to her girlfriend (parasocially speaking, of course) and muse, Harley AKA Lunaticker.  Pulling and remixing from Harley's own words and body of work, Dirkradia drags it along on a quest to turn suicidal ideation into homicidal ideation. 

[From [url=https://dirkradia.itch.io/hello-harley-goodbye-daydrinking]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
Dirkradia让她的女朋友（当然，从超社会角度来说）和缪斯Harley（又名Lunaticker）知道了她的存在。迪尔克拉迪亚从哈利自己的话语和作品中汲取并重新混合，继续探索将自杀意念转变为杀人意念。

[来自[url=https://dirkradia.itch.io/hello-harley-goodbye-daydrinking]itch.io[/url]]
